verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a full REST API for provisioning and managing connectors/pipelines programmatically, corroborated by a live runtime probe showing the API is reachable and correctly auth-gated. There's also an official Connector SDK and community-referenced MCP server enabling agentic interaction. Missing for 10: independent developer corroboration of full API coverage/reliability and a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and one community comment notes API unreliability.
